description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You come up with a unique and ingenious way to accomplish a task, taking longer to achieve your goal with better results. [[/act perform]] a skill action that takes a single action to perform and requires a skill check to accomplish or measure its success, such as an Acrobatics check to [[/act balance]], a Medicine check to [[/act treat-poison]], or a Stealth check to [[/act hide]]. Roll this skill check twice, and use the better result.
